name: Semiconductor Device Physics
summary: How diodes, BJTs and MOSFETs actually work, from junction physics to short-channel effects, FinFETs and compact models.

topics.name: PN diode I-V, capacitance, breakdown and switching behaviour
MOS capacitor: accumulation, depletion, inversion, C-V curves
MOSFET threshold voltage, I-V characteristics and body effect
Short-channel effects: DIBL, velocity saturation, hot carriers
Advanced transistors: SOI, FinFET and gate-all-around nanosheets
Compound-semiconductor devices: HEMT, HBT, GaN and SiC
Device compact models for circuit simulation (BSIM)
